notes.title: Super Simp is approaching
notes.content:
This update is dedicated to the feedback I have received and contains some new features along with some bug fixes.

New: 
- Can now press space to roll which can dodge attacks
- New Super Simp enemy that can throw fireballs
- Updated visuals to the playground map

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where you could damage simps without attack
- Fixed a bug where enemies could spawn in walls
- Fixed a bug where enemies could attack you when they were hit
